comment: Modifier catalogue: id -> name, description and overrides. An override is {doc, path, set}: doc is shift | stations | items | tickets | tuning, path is a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901), set replaces the value there, or adds it when the path is new ('-' appends to an array; the parent must exist). A Shift lists the Modifiers it wants in 'modifiers'; the Room panel can force each on or off before a Reload. Applied in sorted id order, each in its listed order.
